title: Ops Actorization: Compile Runbooks into Composable Admin Actors
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Convert existing runbooks and ad-hoc admin scripts into a library of typed, composable 'Admin Actors' that can be executed by the support console, CLI, and programmatic APIs. Goal is to reduce manual remediation time, improve observability of automated fixes, and enable safe dry-runs for oncall. This ticket focuses on the compiler and runtime shape: a typed input/output contract, idempotency checks, safety guards (RBAC and approval hooks), and telemetry payloads for auditability.
acceptance_criteria: Compiler can ingest a subset of existing runbook DSL (steps + param schema) and emit a versioned actor artifact
Actor runtime enforces typed inputs and returns structured outcomes (success|partial|failed) with traceable telemetry
Console can list and run actors in dry-run mode with no side effects
Rollout includes a feature-flagged canary that only allows internal SRE group to execute in production
Security review completed and integration tests that assert RBAC gating
steps: Kickoff with PM and SRE to gather 10 canonical runbooks to model (2/12)
Draft compile spec + type schema and share with Design for console surface (2/18)
Build initial compiler prototype that converts DSL -> actor metadata + step handlers (2/24)
Implement runtime validation + idempotency checks; add audit event hooks (3/02)
Integrate dry-run plumbing into Console and CLI (3/07)
Run internal canary with SRE and collect UX/telemetry feedback (3/09)
Address safety edge-cases, finalize PRs, and prepare docs + runbooks for rollout (3/15)
Schedule security review and release window (3/20)
Production rollout to 10% capacity with automatic rollback on error budget breach (3/31)
decisions: Use a subset of the existing runbook DSL rather than inventing a new language — reduces migration work
Actor artifacts will be JSON-LD-like typed manifests (simple, human-readable) rather than a binary blob
Idempotency model chosen: step-level replay tokens + optimistic guard (cheaper than full transactional log)
Telemetry events will include token-level cost metadata and a redacted inputs snapshot for audits
Feature-flag-first rollout with canary group = internal SRE and Support; gradual expansion after 1 week of stable metrics
